===Levels 21–39: Red crabs===
'''Requires partial completion of the [[Pandemonium]] and 10 [[Construction]] to build the crab traps.'''

From level 21 to 39, catch [[Red crab (Hunter)|red crabs]] at [[The Pandemonium]]. For initial setup bring a [[hammer]], a [[saw]], 2 [[plank]]s, 4 [[nails]] and 2 [[bucket]]s to build 2 traps next to each other. Afterwards bring [[fish offcuts]] and simply trap the crabs. Players can gain 31,000 experience per hour with two traps. Banking the crabs can be done at a nearby bank.
